review_method: Read existing JSONL/NPZ only; independently sum named pad forces, reconstruct hand-relative transforms from raw WXYZ quaternions, recompute committed Panda joint bounds and all contact extrema, recompute original FP32 geometric success at each pre-reset policy boundary.

clock_semantics.command_submit_clock_limit: Host timestamp immediately before ReferenceRunner.step_reference_action; controller-admission cadence, not directly instrumented motor-application timestamps.

reset_review.reset_difference: Hole/support fixed pose; source-like TCP xyz/yaw and held-peg draws; NumPy RNG; 30 zero-arm-torque closure steps. This is adapted reset, not matched PhysX initialization.

interpretation.observed: Early alternating arm velocity/torque saturation and loss of bilateral grasp precede the first joint-limit gate failures. Peak whole-episode penetration is support/hand, not peg/hole.
interpretation.hypothesis_not_isolated_proof: Adapted Panda dynamics and physical-rate PD/discretization/actuator mismatch are plausible explanations. This experiment does not prove a PPO algorithm defect or a single causal mechanism.
interpretation.joint_limit_verification: Independent raw-qpos check against frozen baseline arm bounds and pinned Panda finger defaults.
interpretation.free_peg_structure_scope: Frozen S1B source and recorded structural gate; no fresh simulator compilation in this review.
remaining_limits: No matched cross-engine initial state/RNG parity
No controlled ablation of inertia/contact/controller mismatch
Only one smoke attempt and zero fully gate-valid episodes
Actor subprocess peak RSS was not measured by this physics audit
No S2B, additional seeds, policy or physics reruns
